--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Candidate Name     : Maya Patel
Candidate Email    : maya.patel@example.com
Position Applied   : Senior AI / NLP Engineer (Python & LLMs)
Interview Round    : AI Architecture & Deep Learning Technical Screen
Interviewer        : Alex Morgan
Session Duration   : 45 Minutes

2. EVALUATION & SCORECARD RATINGS (1 - 5 STARS)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
• Technical Depth: ★★★★★ (5/5) - Superb knowledge of distributed event architecture.

Final Recommendation: STRONG_YES

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

• [04:15] Deep dive into microservices migration
• [22:30] Live architecture whiteboarding

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[00:02] Alex Morgan: Hello Maya Patel, welcome to the AI Architecture & Deep Learning Technical Screen round.
[00:10] Maya Patel: Thank you, glad to be here and excited to discuss the role.
